description: This is a unit test class for the {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel} class, testing its immutability, equality, containment methods, and constants.

classes.name: DittoAcknowledgementLabelTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior and properties of {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel}.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel} class is immutable, also confirming that {@link AcknowledgementLabel} is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the hashCode and equals implementations for {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel} work correctly using EqualsVerifier and that instances behave as expected.

methods.name: containsNullIsFalse
methods.description: Checks that the static method {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel.contains} returns false when null is passed.

methods.name: doesNotContainGivenLabel
methods.description: Verifies that {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel} does not contain a label not predefined, like an arbitrary string.

methods.name: containsConstantOfSelf
methods.description: Checks that {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel} contains its own constant.

methods.name: containsGivenLabel
methods.description: Checks that a label equivalent to a constant's string representation is recognized as contained.

methods.name: valuesReturnsAllConstantsInCorrectOrder
methods.description: Ensures that {@link DittoAcknowledgementLabel.values} returns all constants defined as static fields, in the correct order.
